standard.summary: Modulation Guidance 用 pooled text 调制 AdaLN guidance。完整 pooled-text 路由现已接成默认关的 opt-in 技术储备(modulation_guidance_reserve_seam.py):一个零初始化的 PooledTextModulationProjector 把 prompt 池化向量投影成每个 AdaLN 站点的 shift/scale delta(gate 不动),并配套专用 distill loss + 推理投影 context + replay/metadata 契约。原有常量-bias 的 adaln_guidance 仍作为独立的 partial 路由共存。
standard.effect: 开启后,guidance 随 prompt 变化(不再只是常量 bias);默认关(method=none 或未发布 pooled text)时逐位 parity,不改变训练性能或默认输出。
standard.whenToUse: 做 Anima/Newbie 的 pooled-text modulation distillation 研究时(默认关,需显式开启 + 操作员签字)。
standard.avoidWhen: 只想要零风险默认训练时;该路线默认关、不改默认行为,也不替换 partial 的 adaln_guidance。

standard_en.summary: Modulation Guidance modulates the AdaLN guidance with the pooled text. The full pooled-text route is now wired as default-off, opt-in technical groundwork (modulation_guidance_reserve_seam.py): a zero-initialised PooledTextModulationProjector projects the pooled prompt vector into a shift/scale delta for every AdaLN site (the gate is left alone), together with a dedicated distill loss, an inference projection context, and replay/metadata contracts. The original constant-bias adaln_guidance still coexists as a separate partial route.
standard_en.effect: With it on, the guidance varies with the prompt (no longer just a constant bias); with it off (method=none, or no pooled text published) parity is bit-for-bit, and neither training performance nor the default output changes.
standard_en.whenToUse: For research into pooled-text modulation distillation on Anima/Newbie (off by default, requiring explicit enabling plus an operator sign-off).
standard_en.avoidWhen: When you only want zero-risk default training; this route is off by default, does not change default behaviour, and does not replace the partial adaln_guidance.

advanced.principle: 用文本池化向量预测 AdaLN 调制 delta,让 guidance 依赖 prompt 而非简单常量 bias;投影器零初始化 → 装上即恒等。
advanced.intervention: pooled text → PooledTextModulationProjector → 每站点 (shift_δ, scale_δ) 加到 AdaLN 输出(gate 原样) → 专用 distill loss(off=base / on 加 MSE+反传)蒸馏投影器 → 推理经 pooled-text context 复用同一发布路径。base 权重(llm_adapter/timestep_embed/adaln_modulation)零改动。
advanced.expectedImpact: 默认关时不改变训练性能(bitwise parity);开启后增加少量投影计算并让 AdaLN 受 prompt 条件化。真机机制门已验证:85 个站点、投影器从 0 训起、distill 收敛、parity/remove 逐位、faithful 不降级。配色/身份美学质量仍是用户的活。
advanced.tradeoffs: constant-bias 的 adaln_guidance 仍是独立 partial fallback,full 路由不静默替换它。蒸馏/引导质量需 curated 数据 + 真长训(操作员/用户判断)。

advanced_en.principle: Uses the text pooled vector to predict AdaLN modulation deltas, making guidance depend on the prompt rather than a simple constant bias; the projector is zero-initialized → identity upon installation.
advanced_en.intervention: pooled text → PooledTextModulationProjector → per-site (shift_δ, scale_δ) added to AdaLN output (gate untouched) → dedicated distill loss (off = base / on adds MSE + backward) distills the projector → inference reuses the same release path via pooled-text context. Base weights (llm_adapter/timestep_embed/adaln_modulation) unchanged.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Off by default, no change to training performance (bitwise parity); when on, adds a little projector compute and conditions AdaLN on the prompt. On-device mechanism gate verified: 85 sites, projector trained from zero, distillation converges, parity/remove bitwise, faithful not degraded. Color/identity aesthetic quality remains the user's job.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The constant-bias adaln_guidance remains an independent partial fallback; the full route does not silently replace it. Distillation/guidance quality needs curated data + real long runs (operator/user judgment).
